objectives.statement: Recognize which part of a cleft sentence is being emphasized.
Form subject-focused cleft sentences with det er or det var plus som.
Form object, time, and place-focused cleft sentences with normal clause word order after the focused element.
Choose det er or det var to match present or past emphasis.

notes: Must teach cleft sentences for focus/emphasis with det er/var plus som or clause continuation. Include word order after the focused element.
